Class CardPickedEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.Event
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.UpdateEvent
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.CardPickedEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CardPickedEvent extends UpdateEvent
Event representing a card being picked by a player during the game. Inherits from UpdateEvent. It contains the necessary information to update the client-side model, including new player stats, board state, and turn order if the pick phase ends.

  • Constructor Details

    • CardPickedEvent

      public CardPickedEvent(String playerNickname, Card card, int row, int playerFood, int playerPrestigePoints, Optional<ArrayList<Player>> updatedTurnOrderCard, int gameId, int playerBuildingDiscount, int playerGatheringDiscount, int playerNumStars, boolean wasLastPick)
      Constructs a CardPickedEvent triggered by the server model.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player who picked the card.
      card - the Card that was picked, or null if starting the pick phase.
      row - the row index from which the card was picked.
      playerFood - the updated food amount of the player.
      playerPrestigePoints - the updated prestige points of the player.
      updatedTurnOrderCard - an Optional containing the updated turn order, if changed.
      gameId - the ID of the game this event belongs to.
      playerBuildingDiscount - the updated building discount of the player.
      playerGatheringDiscount - the updated gathering discount of the player.
      playerNumStars - the updated number of stars for the player.
      wasLastPick - true if this was the last pick for the current player.

    • CardPickedEvent

      public CardPickedEvent(String playerNickname, int cardID, int row, int playerFood, int playerPrestigePoints, ArrayList<String> updatedTurnOrderCard, String description, int playerBuildingDiscount, int playerGatheringDiscount, int playerNumStars, boolean wasLastPick)
      Constructs a CardPickedEvent from JSON data, used by Jackson upon receiving a message.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player who picked the card.
      cardID - the ID of the picked card.
      row - the row index from which the card was picked.
      playerFood - the updated food amount of the player.
      playerPrestigePoints - the updated prestige points of the player.
      updatedTurnOrderCard - the updated turn order list of player nicknames.
      description - the description of the event.
      playerBuildingDiscount - the updated building discount of the player.
      playerGatheringDiscount - the updated gathering discount of the player.
      playerNumStars - the updated number of stars for the player.
      wasLastPick - true if this was the last pick for the current player.
